text_block_list.text:
—That day.
I am certain I met an angel.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
It's alright... It's okay.
There's nothing to be afraid of.
Won't you come over here for just a moment?
Come on—

At a park I visited during my early morning
walk,
a horsegirl was crouched in front of a bush,
speaking softly to something.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...You're still not quite in the mood,
are you?
Hehe.
Only whenever you're ready;
I'll be right here.

She gives off such a gentle,
fluffy impression.
Who is she talking to? Following her gaze—

text_block_list.name: Cat
choice_data_list: A cat...? Does it live in this par...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...?
Ah... yes, it does.
choice_data_list: Ah... Sorry for suddenly chiming i...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all, please don't mind me.
I was merely talking to the kitty all by
myself anyway.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Just as you said,
this park seems to be the kitty's home...
For as long as I've known,
it has always been here alone.

I leaned down next to her to peer in,
but the cat glared back at us
and backed deeper into the bushes.
It wouldn't let us get anywhere near.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
This little one...
must be terrified of people.
And I think it's unwell,
which makes it even more frightened.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Most likely.
It keeps fretting over its tummy... See,
there it goes again.
...From the look in its eyes and its cry,
it seems to be in pain and distress.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
I hoped to take it to a clinic if possible.
But whenever I try to approach,
it just retreats further back.
I really want to help, but...
choice_data_list: Should I go buy something for it? ...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I brought some with me as well.
However,
it won't eat unless it lets down its guard,
so...
choice_data_list: I see... I hope it warms up to you...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thank you for your kindness.
I'll stay right here until little kitty
feels ready to come out.

Parting ways with her after that,
I went on to finish running my errands—

As if mocking the clear skies of early
morning,
rain began to drizzle from heavy,
drooping clouds.

—Evening arrived,
and I was on my way back from town.
Amidst the pouring rain,
thoughts of that girl and the cat from this
morning crossed my mind once more.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
"I'll stay right here until little kitty
feels ready to come out."

Only the quiet pitter-patter of rain echoed
across the now-darkened hill.
I assumed she would have naturally headed
home by now, but—

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
It's gotten quite chilly, hasn't it...
It'd be terrible if you caught a cold.
I have a towel right here,
so you can wrap yourself up like it's a cozy
blanket.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
So, if it's all right with you...
won't you let a doctor examine you at the
clinic? There's nothing to be afraid of.
I'll stay right by your side the whole
time.

—She was there.
Standing in the rain.
In the exact same spot from this morning.
choice_data_list: Hey...! You don't even have an umb...
Hey...! You don't even have an umb...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ah—from this morning...
Thank you so much for your concern.
choice_data_list: ...Have you been here the entire time?
...Have you been here the entire time?

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to stay close and reassure
it.
To let it know, "You're not all alone"...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
That is why—just a little longer.
We've finally come this far, after all.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Look, see for yourself.
It's come so much closer than it was this
morning.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Little kitty definitely needs treatment.
So—
until it understands that "there's no need
to worry," just a little more.

In the ceaseless rain,
I kept her company during her quiet connection
with the cat.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...
...Come here.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Meoow.

At last,
the cat approached her outstretched hand,
timidly at first—
before eventually rubbing its forehead
against her gently.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. You've decided to trust me,
haven't you?
There's no need to worry.
You're going to be all better soon.

Afterward,
we searched for an emergency animal hospital
open at night and accompanied it there.
It turned out she had already prepared
supplies to transport the cat.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it seems quite comfortable in there.
It'll take a little longer to reach the
hospital,
but we can breathe a sigh of relief for
now.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Little kitty. Once we're done at the hospital,
let's search for a new home together,
okay?
I'll reach out to all sorts of people to
see if anyone can foster you.
choice_data_list: I'll ask around on my end to see i...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Little kitty,
we'll be sure to introduce you to wonderful
foster parents, alright?

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Until then...
I'll stay right beside you so you won't feel
lonely.
So that you can connect with a kind family...
and find true happiness.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Once you're able to eat properly again,
I'll give you some delicious canned cat food
as a celebratory treat.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meoow♪

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe.
I wonder if you understand what I'm
saying.

Was this what they call "pure and innocent"?
I felt that her actions were
rooted in something fundamentally distinct
from the simple sentiment of rescuing an
animal just because it's cute.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
choice_data_list: ...Come to think of it, I never ca...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Ah... hehe♪
That's true, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—I am Victoire Pisa.
I attend Tracen Academy.
It is a pleasure to meet you.

Illuminated by the streetlights,
the young girl smiled.

—Perhaps this is what an angel's smile looks
like.

The girl's smile was pure enough to make
anyone who saw it believe so.
